### [1] [PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07478)
*Jagpal Singh Jhala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了PragyaDoc，一个面向印度本土语言的通用文档智能（Document Intelligence）框架，通过四层流水线（并行集成OCR、几何-词汇融合、确定性领域结构化和双大语言模型医学推理与本地化）解决医疗文档仅以英语存在而大多数患者无法理解的关键可及性障碍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 印度拥有22种官方语言，但绝大多数医疗文档仅以英语书写，导致农村人口、ASHA社区卫生工作者和患者家属等最需要医疗信息的人群被功能性地排除在理解之外，形成了严重的医疗信息可及性壁垒。

Method: PragyaDoc采用四层流水线架构：（1）并行集成OCR提取层，通过多个OCR引擎的集成提高文本提取鲁棒性；（2）几何-词汇融合层，结合文档版面几何信息与词汇语义信息进行内容组织；（3）确定性领域结构化层，利用确定性规则对医学领域信息进行结构化处理；（4）双LLM医学推理与本地化层，通过两个大语言模型协同完成医学推理和语言本地化转换。

Result: 本摘要未提供具体的实验结果或定量分析数据，仅描述了框架的系统设计。该研究目前重点在于提出并验证框架的整体架构可行性。

Conclusion: PragyaDoc通过多层次的文档处理流水线，将仅以英语存在的医学文档转化为印度各本地语言可理解的形式，从而弥合医疗信息在语言层面的可及性鸿沟，有望提升印度本土医疗服务的信息公平性。

Original Abstract: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

中文摘要翻译: 印度拥有22种官方语言，这构成了一个关键的医疗可及性障碍：绝大多数医疗文档仅以英语存在，而最迫切需要这些信息的患者群体——农村人口、ASHA社区卫生工作者和患者家属——在功能上却无法理解这些内容。本文提出了PragyaDoc，一个通用文档智能（Document Intelligence）框架，通过四层流水线来解决这一鸿沟：并行集成OCR提取层、几何-词汇融合层、确定性领域结构化层，以及双大语言模型（dual-LLM）医学推理与本地化层。

</details>


### [2] [NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07541)
*Yiyao Chen,Yucheng Li,Jungong Tong,Shaoqi Wang,Kunhao Zhou,Ziquan Wei,Monica Murea,Marissa DiPiero,Tingting Dan,Guorong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroPilot是一个基于多智能体LLM的神经影像数据处理系统，将数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制三个环节封装为三个可调用的LLM技能，实现全流程自动化编排，已在17个队列（超过12.3万被试）上验证，可将传统2-3个月的处理周期压缩至一周。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 神经影像数据从原始归档转化为分析就绪的衍生数据依赖于三个脆弱环节：数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制（QC）。虽然单个影像处理工具已很成熟，但它们的编排需要项目特定的脚本、环境自适应调参和耗时的手动QC，缺乏高效、可扩展的自动化解决方案。

Method: NeuroPilot是一个多智能体系统，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能：dcm2bids-skill（数据标准化）、neuroimage-pre-skill（模态特定预处理）和qc-agent-skill（质量控制）。LLM驱动的智能体自主编排工作流，将各种基础设施设置泛化为单一配置，并通过3D浏览器仪表盘实现基于证据的半自动QC，采用多层级验证系统优化失败案例并升级复杂问题供专家检查。

Result: NeuroPilot在17个队列（>123,000被试）上部署，覆盖从婴儿到老龄人群及多种MRI模态（结构、弥散、功能）。QC智能体筛查了558个生产被试，自动化标记与FreeSurfer拓扑缺陷指标验证一致；婴儿处理流水线在QC验证输入上达到100%（201/201）完成率；将传统2-3个月的训练和完整数据集处理时间压缩至一周。

Conclusion: NeuroPilot通过LLM驱动的多智能体架构成功实现了神经影像数据全流程自动化的高可扩展性和泛化能力，显著提升了处理效率并减少了人工干预，为大规模多队列神经影像数据分析提供了可靠的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

中文摘要翻译: 将原始神经影像档案转化为分析就绪的衍生数据依赖于三个脆弱的环节：数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制（QC）。尽管单个神经影像工具已发展成熟，但其编排需要项目特定的脚本、环境自适应的调参以及劳动密集的手动QC。为解决这一问题，我们引入NeuroPilot，一个多智能体系统，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能：dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill和qc-agent-skill。LLM驱动的智能体自主编排工作流，将各种基础设施设置泛化为单一配置以实现最高可扩展性。为展示系统的泛化能力，我们在17个队列（超过123,000名被试）上部署了NeuroPilot，覆盖从婴儿到老龄人群以及多种MRI模态（结构、弥散、功能）。在实践中，通过dcm2bids-skill标准化数据后，智能体根据可用模态和队列特征动态地将数据集路由至最优的neuroimage-pre-skill（例如，将T1w和fMRI数据分配给fMRIPrep，或为婴儿队列选择专门流水线）。随后，qc-agent-skill通过3D浏览器仪表盘驱动基于证据的半自动QC，利用多层级验证系统优化失败案例，并将复杂问题升级至监督员检查。在定量评估中，我们的QC智能体筛查了558个生产被试，将其自动化标记与FreeSurfer的拓扑缺陷指标进行验证。婴儿处理流水线在QC验证的输入上实现了100%（201/201）的完成率。重要的是，NeuroPilot将传统上训练人员和完整数据集处理所需的2-3个月时间压缩至一周。NeuroPilot已部署于https://wanda-cyberbench.com/。

</details>


### [3] [Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07543)
*Joshua C. Vences,William T. Tran,Nikko Gimpaya,Catharine M. Walsh,Rishad J. Khan,Robert Bechara,Asher C. Wiggins,Celine N. Rousan,Kaitlyn V. G. L. Morgado,Angie Ibrahim,Kevin H. M. Kuo,Daniel von Renteln,Alexander Hann,Dennis L. Shung,Michael A. Scaffidi,Charles Ménard,Joshua Landy,Samir C. Grover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了五种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在结直肠息肉光学诊断中的准确性，使用PRIME数据集（包含白光和窄带成像图像），比较了五个模型在巴黎分型、NICE分型和组织学预测方面的表现，发现Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro表现最佳，但灵敏度和特异度未达到ESGE标准。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断对于指导切除策略和监测方案至关重要，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的诊断中展现出潜力，但目前尚缺乏对其在结直肠息肉分类和组织学预测中诊断准确性的系统评估。

Method: 该研究为回顾性诊断性能研究，使用PRIME数据集（包含白光和窄带成像图像），评估Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o和GPT-5五种MLLM。对132例病例计算F1分数、百分正确分数和准确率，并与专家应答进行比较；使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验确定各MLLM预测值之间的差异。

Result: 所有模型在肿瘤性vs.非肿瘤性息肉的F1分数均>0.9；Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性vs.非浸润性息肉和低级别vs.高级别腺瘤方面F1分数最高（分别为0.560和0.492）；Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在巴黎分型中的百分正确分数显著高于其他模型（41.7%）。

Conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面准确性最高，最接近专家共识。然而，其灵敏度和特异度未达到ESGE标准，强调需要进行前瞻性多中心试验，并在临床部署前设计人机协作（human-in-the-loop）流程。

Original Abstract: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 背景与研究目的：结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断可指导切除策略和监测方案，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的诊断中展现出潜力。本研究旨在评估MLLMs在结直肠息肉分类和组织学预测中的诊断准确性。方法：我们利用PRIME数据集（包含白光和窄带成像[ NBI ]图像的精选数据集）开展了一项回顾性诊断性能研究。我们评估了Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o和GPT-5。针对132例病例，我们计算了各MLLM在巴黎分型、窄带成像结直肠内镜（NICE）分型及预测组织学方面的F1分数、百分正确分数和准确率，并与专家应答进行比较。采用Cochran's Q检验和McNemar检验确定各MLLM预测值之间的差异。结果：所有模型在肿瘤性vs.非肿瘤性息肉的分类中F1分数均>0.9。Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性vs.非浸润性息肉和低级别vs.高级别腺瘤的分类中F1分数最高，分别为0.560和0.492。Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在巴黎分型中的百分正确分数为41.7%，显著高于其他MLLM。结论：Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面准确性最高，最接近专家共识。然而，其灵敏度和特异度未达到ESGE标准，这凸显了在临床部署之前开展前瞻性多中心试验以及设计人机协作（human-in-the-loop）工作流程的必要性。

</details>


### [4] [Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07547)
*Yuhao Lu,Weichen Zhang,Wenyi Xiao,Haohui Chen,Yiyun Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LayoutDSL，一种基于LLM的室内场景布局生成框架，通过将布局推理建模为领域特定语言（DSL）中的结构化动作空间策略学习，并辅以强化学习优化，显著提升了布局的空间合理性与设计逻辑性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有室内布局生成方法将任务过度简化，仅用粗粒度3D边界框表示房间条件并忽略门窗等结构元素；更根本的问题是，许多方法将空间推理建模为对原始几何参数的连续回归，阻碍了模型学习智能布局设计背后的推理逻辑。

Method: 1）提出LayoutDSL框架，在领域特定语言（DSL）动作空间中学习室内布局策略，DSL提供布局信息的显式符号表示并作为结构化的推理动作空间，每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策；2）构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，包含房间结构标注与合成DSL动作序列，用于监督微调；3）设计基于室内设计原则和物理合理性约束的奖励函数，通过强化学习优化策略，使策略更具泛化性和可扩展性并获得可验证的反馈。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面显著优于强基线方法和现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将布局生成从连续坐标回归转变为DSL结构化动作空间的策略学习，并引入基于设计原则的强化学习优化，可以有效提升室内布局生成的空间合理性与设计逻辑性，为智能室内设计提供了一种新的范式。

Original Abstract: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

中文摘要翻译: 室内场景布局生成是室内设计中的一项具有挑战性的任务。现有方法往往通过将房间条件简化为粗粒度的3D边界框来过度简化任务，并且忽略了门窗等结构元素。更根本的是，许多先前的方法将空间推理表述为直接的坐标预测，从而将室内布局设计视为对原始几何参数的连续回归，这阻碍了模型学习智能布局设计背后的推理逻辑。我们提出\textbf{LayoutDSL}，一种新颖的基于LLM的框架，用于在领域特定语言（DSL）动作空间中学习室内布局策略。DSL提供了布局信息的显式符号表示，并作为布局推理的结构化动作空间，其中每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策。在这种基于DSL的策略学习范式下，我们构建了3D-FrontDSL，一个包含房间结构标注和合成DSL动作序列的数据集，用于监督微调。为了促进具有可验证反馈的更通用、可扩展的策略，我们设计了基于室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励函数，并通过强化学习优化策略。大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面显著优于强基线和现有方法。

</details>


### [5] [P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07549)
*Zhenhong Sun,Haozhe Liu,Yifu Wang,Xibin Song,Senbo Wang,Huadong Mo,Daoyi Dong,Hongdong Li,Pan Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P2Voxel，一种金字塔枢轴体素化框架，将网格tokenization重新定义为"局部表面证据采样"，通过表面枢轴+方向符号作为最小局部证据、金字塔结构按空间复杂度分配token、以及基于块可重构性的金字塔VAE学习多分辨率潜码，实现紧凑、结构化、可学习的网格tokenization，支持高效的3D网格重建。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 三维网格具有显式且精确的表面几何，但其不规则的拓扑连接使得网格tokenization成为一个几何采样问题：如何将几何证据采样并组织成紧凑、结构化且可学习的token。已有的场中心体积采样和边相交表面采样方法未能充分解决这一挑战，需要一种新方案来决定每个活跃体素内部哪些最小几何证据足以实现确定性表面恢复。

Method: P2Voxel基于三个关键创新构建：(1) 在局部平面性假设下，枢轴体素化（Pivot Voxelization）用表面枢轴和方向符号表示每个活跃体素，提供可诱导确定性重建所需角值的最小局部证据；(2) 在空间复杂度假设下，金字塔枢轴体素化（Pyramid Pivot Voxelization）利用真实表面的空间非均匀性，对几何复杂区域分配更细的枢轴token，对平滑区域保持粗粒度紧凑表示；(3) 在块可重构性假设下，金字塔VAE（Pyramid VAE）在局部可重构枢轴块上学习紧凑的多分辨率潜码，避免将整个高分辨率体素化形状建模为稠密全局场。

Result: 该方法将网格转换为紧凑、结构化、可学习的金字塔枢轴token，实现高效的下游3D任务网格重建。

Conclusion: 通过将网格tokenization重新概念化为局部表面证据采样，P2Voxel以最小几何证据实现确定性表面恢复，兼顾了表示的紧凑性、结构的规则性和学习的可及性，为下游3D任务提供高效的网格重建基础。

Original Abstract: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 三角形网格提供了显式且精确的表面几何，但其不规则的拓扑连接使得3D网格tokenization成为一个几何采样问题：如何将几何证据采样并组织成紧凑、结构化且可学习的token。超越以场为中心的体积采样和边相交表面采样，我们将网格tokenization重新定位为\textit{局部表面证据采样}：识别每个活跃体素内足以实现确定性表面恢复的最小几何证据。为此，我们提出了\textbf{P2Voxel}，一个用于紧凑且重建感知的网格tokenization的金字塔枢轴体素化框架。P2Voxel建立在三个关键创新之上。在\textit{局部平面性}假设下，枢轴体素化（Pivot Voxelization）用表面枢轴和方向符号表示每个活跃体素，提供能够诱导确定性重建所需角值的最小局部证据。在\textit{空间复杂度}假设下，金字塔枢轴体素化（Pyramid Pivot Voxelization）利用真实表面的空间非均匀性，为几何复杂区域分配更精细的枢轴token，同时保持平滑区域粗粒度且紧凑。在\textit{块可重构性}假设下，金字塔VAE（Pyramid VAE）在局部可重构的枢轴块上学习紧凑的多分辨率潜码，避免将整个高分辨率体素化形状建模为稠密的全局场。这些设计共同将网格转换为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴token，从而实现下游3D任务的高效网格重建。

</details>

*Pengyang Yu,Yiou Wang,Zhongping Dong,Sahraoui Dhelim,Chun-Mei Feng,M. Tahar Kechadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估了三个生成式视觉-语言模型在三个机构胸部X光语料库上、六种发现类型下、两种诱发协议中超过34.5万条发现级预测的参考标准一致性，发现接收机构不能简单跨机构借用一致性估计，且推荐的估计器(Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯和目标逻辑模型)间差异极小、无默认最优方案，参考一致性必须按机构和接口逐一重新评估。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在返回胸部X光检查发现时不暴露置信度分数，接收机构无法直接判断单个判断的可信程度。关于模型预测与机构参考标准的一致性是否能够跨站点、跨发现类型、跨预测方向和跨提问格式迁移，目前缺乏系统的测量。

Method: 在三个机构胸部X光语料库上，对三个生成式视觉-语言模型、六种发现类型、两种诱发协议进行评估，产生超过34.5万个发现级预测。使用少量本地标注预算估计接收机构处的按发现-方向参考一致性，并测试七种估计策略（包括Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯估计器、仅目标逻辑回归模型以及跨机构池化估计器等），在严格排除接收机构的重复留出评估下进行压力测试。

Result: 自适应选择七种估计器并未优于简单固定方案：平均Brier分数为0.1083，而始终使用Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯估计器为0.0853，仅目标逻辑模型为0.0855。后两者差异仅0.0003，小于该系列对求解器版本变化的敏感性，且各在约半数设置中领先，无法推荐默认方案。跨机构池化估计器的优势集中在一个站点且按机构聚类后不具确认性。名义95%水平的plug-in经验贝叶斯后验预测计数区间实际覆盖率为87.0%，在最难的机构更低。

Conclusion: 参考一致性必须按站点和按接口逐一重新评估；研究结果涉及与机构标签的一致性，而非临床正确性。

Original Abstract: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.

*Eduardo de los Santos,Andre S. Kelbouscas,Ricardo B. Grando,Bruna V. Guterres*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了数据集组成对嵌入式实时UAV野火检测性能的影响，通过对比四种训练配置（真实未增强、真实增强、混合未增强、混合增强）发现，真实未增强数据集在召回率和平均精度均值上取得了最佳平衡，而AI生成数据与数据增强均未带来更好的部署性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 基于视觉的无人机野火检测系统受限于多样化真实训练图像的匮乏，因此需要探究数据集构成（如是否混入合成数据、是否进行图像增强）对嵌入式实时检测性能的实际影响，以指导数据集的构建策略。

Method: 以紧凑型YOLO模型作为受控验证模型族，构建四种训练配置：真实未增强、真实增强、混合未增强和混合增强。其中混合数据集由真实野火图像与AI生成的合成样本组合而成，在资源受限的嵌入式部署条件下评估各配置的检测性能。

Result: 真实未增强数据集取得了最佳整体工作点，在召回率与平均精度均值之间达到了最强平衡；混合合成数据或数据增强均未产生更优的最终部署选择。

Conclusion: 对于嵌入式UAV野火检测，数据集的真实性和领域对齐比通过合成扩展增加训练集规模更具价值。

Original Abstract: The development of vision-based wildfire detection systems for unmanned aerial vehicles is constrained by the limited availability of diverse real-world training images. This paper investigates the impact of dataset composition on embedded real-time UAV wildfire detection using compact YOLO models as a controlled validation family. Four training configurations were evaluated: real non-augmented, real augmented, hybrid non-augmented, and hybrid augmented, where the hybrid sets combine real wildfire images with AI-generated samples. The objective is to determine whether synthetic data mixing and image augmentation improve practical detection performance under resource-constrained deployment conditions. Experimental results show that the best overall operating point was obtained with the real non-augmented dataset, which achieved the strongest balance between recall and mean average precision for UAV-based wildfire detection. The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.

中文摘要翻译: 基于视觉的无人机野火检测系统的发展受到多样化真实世界训练图像可用性有限的制约。本文以紧凑型YOLO模型作为受控验证模型族，研究了数据集组成对嵌入式实时UAV野火检测的影响。研究评估了四种训练配置：真实未增强、真实增强、混合未增强和混合增强，其中混合数据集将真实野火图像与AI生成的样本相结合。目标是确定在资源受限的部署条件下，合成数据混合和图像增强是否能够提升实际检测性能。实验结果表明，最佳整体工作点由真实未增强数据集获得，该配置在无人机野火检测的召回率与平均精度均值之间达到了最强平衡。结果还表明，无论是与合成数据混合还是数据增强，均未产生更优的最终部署选择。这些发现表明，对于嵌入式UAV野火检测，数据集的真实性和领域对齐比通过合成扩展增大训练集规模更具价值。

</details>


### [8] [MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07559)
*Yidan Shen,Yu Wen,Chen Zhang,Xin Fu,Renjie Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MVMD，一种多视角镜像检测方法，利用跨视角和自注意力机制捕捉物体在多视角间及镜内外的关联，以提升多视角三维重建中镜像环境的检测精度和重建准确性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 三维重建中，镜子会引入失真和碎片化的空间，导致三维模型不准确。多视角图像包含丰富的互补信息，但现有镜像检测方法仅针对单张图像，忽视了多视角设置下提供的丰富信息，无法有效解决重建前镜像检测的问题。

Method: MVMD由三个关键模块组成：Inter-Views Block通过跨视角注意力跟踪视点变化引起的镜内物体位移；Intra-View Block通过自注意力检测镜内物体的反射；Refinement Block通过细化机制锐化镜子边界并增强检测细节。同时，论文构建了首个专门用于多视角场景镜像检测的数据库。

Result: 实验结果表明，与单图像镜面检测技术相比，MVMD的精度最高提升2.6%，IoU最高提升11.1%，显著改善了多视角下镜面检测的性能。

Conclusion: MVMD充分利用多视角信息进行镜面检测，显著优于单图像方法，在镜像密集环境中对提升三维重建精度尤为有效，适用于计算机视觉相关任务。

Original Abstract: In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes.
  The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.
  Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

中文摘要翻译: 在三维重建中，镜子会引入显著的挑战，造成空间失真和碎片化，导致三维模型不准确且不可靠。由于三维重建通常依赖多视角图像来捕捉场景的不同视角，因此在重建之前对多视角图像中的镜子进行检测和标注可以有效解决这一问题。然而，现有方法仅专注于单幅图像的检测，忽视了多视角设置所提供的丰富信息。为克服这一局限，我们提出了MVMD，一种新颖的多视角镜像检测方法，以及首个专门为多视角场景中镜像检测而设计的数据库。MVMD的设计基于从不同视角观察到的物体与镜内镜外反射物体之间的内在关联，这些关系通过交叉注意力与自注意力机制进行学习。MVMD包含三个关键模块：视图间模块（Inter-Views Block）跟踪由视点变化引起的镜内物体位移；视图内模块（Intra-View Block）检测镜内物体的反射；细化模块（Refinement Block）锐化镜像边界并增强检测到的细节。实验结果表明，与单幅图像镜像检测技术相比，我们的方法精度最高提升2.6%，IoU最高提升11.1%。这一显著提升使得MVMD在计算机视觉任务中尤其有效，特别是在增强镜像密集环境中三维重建的准确性方面。

</details>

Original Abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a silent disease. Its progression may not significantly hamper a person's daily routine. Human kidney function can be classified as normal or as one of the five stages of CKD. Early detection of the CKD stage can help patients understand the functional status of their kidneys and follow medical advice to slow CKD progression. Result: FloodLlama-Dense达到MAE 0.40cm、RMSE 1.97cm、Acc@5cm 97.59%。机制分析揭示两阶段适应模式：L13-L22层重构视觉表征，深度信息最早在L23层可线性解码。FloodLlama-MI5和MI6仅微调8个交叉注意力层中的5-6层，可训练参数从54.4M降至6.55-7.86M（减少86-88%），精度损失极小。在真实世界基准上，FloodLlama-MI6达到98.62%准确率，远超STURM-FloodDepth基线的86.61%。

Original Abstract: Urban flooding poses an escalating threat to transportation infrastructure, yet no operational system provides real-time, street-level flood-depth estimates at centimeter resolution. This paper presents three vision-language models fine-tuned for continuous flood-depth estimation from street-level imagery: FloodLlama-Dense, a fully fine-tuned QLoRA baseline, and FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6, interpretability-guided sparse variants that fine-tune only the top five and six causally relevant cross-attention layers identified through mechanistic interpretability analysis, respectively. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LHSDet，一种基于视觉-语言框架的高分辨率AI生成图像检测器，采用三分支架构（低级视觉分支、高级视觉分支、语义级文本分支）分别提取局部纹理线索、全局感知特征和语义特征，通过多模态特征融合实现对扩散模型和自回归模型生成图像的高精度检测。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Original Abstract: Driven by advances in diffusion models and autoregressive models, the fidelity and resolution of AI-generated images now rival those of real images. However, existing AI-generated image detection methods often downsample the images, inevitably overlooking critical low-level texture details in high-resolution AI-generated images, therefore limiting their detection performance. Consequently, LHSDet employs a triple-branch architecture to extract complementary multi-modal features: a low-level visual branch that aggregates non-overlapping patches for local texture cues, a high-level visual branch based on SigLIP2 for global perception feature extraction, and a semantic-level textual branch that generates captions using BLIP-2. TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段框架，用于在图像生成对话中推荐后续编辑建议。首先利用真实在线数据构建人工审核的编辑意图表并微调多模态策略；其次通过多目标强化学习利用用户点击反馈对齐建议；最后引入视觉验证器减少建议与实际图像间的视觉不一致。在线A/B测试显示视觉不一致率从3.7%降至0.9%，CTR提升32.70%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有对话助手的后续编辑推荐系统主要局限于纯文本交互，图像生成场景下的编辑建议推荐尚未被充分探索。在图像创建任务中，有用的后续编辑建议需要反映用户偏好、提供多样化方向，且必须在当前图像上可执行。从Qwen App收集的10万个真实多轮图像生成对话样本中，80.1%是图像相关的，这凸显了对多模态推荐的需求。

Method: 提出三阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段，基于真实在线数据构建经人工审核的后续编辑意图表，创建SFT目标并微调多模态策略；(2) 第二阶段，利用用户点击反馈通过多目标强化学习优化策略，使规则引导的SFT建议与真实用户选择对齐；(3) 第三阶段，引入视觉验证器作为额外训练监督，以减少建议编辑与当前图像之间的视觉不一致性。

Result: 大规模实验表明该框架在自动和人工评估上均显著优于基线。在数百万用户的线上随机A/B测试中，视觉不一致率从3.7%降至0.9%；推荐CTR提升32.70%，图像采纳率提升16.32%，用户平均对话轮次提升39.90%（全部p<0.05）。

Conclusion: 通过三阶段框架（SFT微调、多目标强化学习对齐、视觉验证器监督），可以有效地在图像生成对话中实现高质量的后继编辑建议推荐，显著降低视觉不一致性并提升用户参与度和交互效果。

We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

### [13] [EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08066)
*Junsik Jung,Seokryun Choi,Yoonki Cho,Woo Jae Kim,Andrew Jeong,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EvBS，一个事件引导的模糊合成框架，利用事件相机的高时间分辨率将运动与视觉内容解耦，通过内在模糊合成和外在模糊合成两种策略生成多样化的训练对，用于微调预训练的去模糊模型，以应对真实场景中的域偏移问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 预训练的去模糊模型在真实场景中常因训练与测试分布之间的域偏移而性能退化。现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容之间的固有关联，难以有效生成多样化的训练数据来校准模型到目标域。

Method: EvBS利用事件相机的高时间分辨率来解耦运动与视觉内容，包含两种互补策略：(1) 内在模糊合成（Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis），用目标内容自身的运动模式对清晰图像进行模糊；(2) 外在模糊合成（Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis），将模糊块中的运动转移到不同的清晰内容上。这两种策略生成多样化的训练对，打破运动与内容自然耦合的固有约束，通过微调实现域自适应。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EvBS有效增强了现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性，取得了改进的域自适应去模糊性能。

Conclusion: EvBS通过事件引导的运动-内容解耦，突破了传统方法中运动与内容固有耦合的局限，为域自适应的去模糊模型校准提供了有效且通用的训练数据合成方案。

Original Abstract: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.

中文摘要翻译: 运动去模糊借助深度学习已取得显著进展，然而预训练的去模糊模型在真实场景中常常因训练与测试分布之间的域偏移而遭受性能退化。为解决这一问题，我们提出EvBS，一种事件引导的模糊合成框架，用于生成多样化的训练对，以将预训练模型校准到目标域。现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容之间的固有关联，而我们的方法利用事件相机的高时间分辨率有效地将两者解耦。这使得我们不仅能够利用给定内容自身固有的内在运动，还能利用从目标域不同来源迁移而来的外在运动，从而通过微调实现有效的适配。具体而言，EvBS包含两种互补策略：内在模糊合成（Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis），即用清晰内容自身的运动模式对其施加模糊；以及外在模糊合成（Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis），即将模糊块中的运动迁移到不同的清晰内容上。该方法生成多样化的训练对，打破自然耦合的运动与内容之间的固有约束，从而提升域自适应的去模糊性能。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EvBS有效增强了现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性。

Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. 中文摘要翻译: 功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）是自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中一种有前景的模态，然而现有方法假设时序对齐的评估。在实践中，由于血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合的差异，最优观测窗口因受试者而异，造成了降低性能的时间分布偏移。我们将此形式化为一个\textit{跨时间窗口迁移问题}，引入一种在生物运动试验中改变窗口长度（2.5–10秒）和偏移量的协议。利用fNIRS记录的地形图表示，我们在留一受试者交叉验证（N=124）下，对三种视觉架构在两种零样本基线和八种自适应策略下进行基准测试。关键发现：（1）零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机水平（54–69%）；（2）约5%的受试者特定微调可恢复90–96%，而受试者特定上界可达97–100%，表明受试者间变异性是主要障碍；（3）无需目标受试者数据的域对抗与自监督策略可达78–90%；（4）短至2.5秒的窗口即可恢复判别性信息。这些发现为在现实时间变异条件下部署基于fNIRS的ASD分类器提供了实用路线图。

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

The unconstrained reflectance ratio is the pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimate, with a boundary solution for zero-valued observations; the implemented estimate additionally applies illumination filtering and range clipping. The NB model is a diagnostic noise analysis rather than a calibrated sensor model, and the final fixed-bandwidth bilateral filter is an empirical approximation rather than the exact Bayesian solution. On the LOL-v1 dataset, the methodobtains mean PSNR/SSIM of 17.74dB/0.739, the highest values among the evaluated with conventional methods.   <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 直接在video-VAE潜在空间中进行谱编辑可以避免"解码-滤波-再编码"的昂贵流程，但视频VAE会将像素空间频带重新分配到不同潜在通道中，且潜在编辑可能破坏VAE的往返（round-trip）动力学。因此需要一个能感知VAE特异性谱响应、并确保编辑有效性和稳定性的方法。

Conclusion: LFV证明可以在video-VAE潜在空间中进行高效、有效且可泛化的直接频谱编辑，其验证选择的路径（C1→CM）能够在复杂度和频谱编辑质量之间取得良好平衡。实验揭示不同VAE存在不同响应机制：CogVideoX呈现强通道耦合响应，Open-Sora存在锐利的高频稳定性边界，这些发现为理解VAE的谱行为提供了新视角。

Main category: cs.CV

To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. 中文摘要翻译: 可解释的美学图像裁剪不仅需要定位出视觉上令人满意的裁剪区域，还需要解释为何该裁剪更受青睐。现有的裁剪与解释方法大多将解释视为事后文本生成，而忽略了构图——这一将裁剪决策与可解释推理联系起来的核心美学因素。在本文中，我们将可解释的美学图像裁剪重新表述为结构化的"裁剪-构图-解释"问题。为支持这一设定，我们提出了COMEX——一个通过图像扩展和IO反转流水线构建的新基准。COMEX包含33,161个四元组，每个四元组由扩展图像、裁剪框、构图类别和基于构图的解释组成，从而支持裁剪定位、构图理解和解释生成的联合学习。我们进一步提出了一种两阶段SFT+GRPO框架，其中监督微调建立了结构化输出协议和基本裁剪能力，而GRPO则进一步提升了裁剪质量、构图预测和解释忠实度。我们在COMEX上对15个大视觉语言模型和现有裁剪方法进行了基准测试，为基于构图的可解释美学裁剪建立了全面的测试平台。在COMEX和先前基准上的实验均证明了我们框架的有效性和可迁移性，各项评估指标均表现出色。

Motivation: 锚点类车道检测器性能受两个耦合问题限制：一是骨干网络特征在车道部分遮挡时丧失结构连续性；二是分类置信度与线级定位质量解耦，导致非极大值抑制（NMS）前不准确的锚点得以保留。这两者共同制约了检测精度。

Method: 提出结构增强与质量感知框架：（1）门控水平-垂直Token（GHVT）模块通过轻量级方向性Token交互和可学习的残差门增强中高层骨干特征；（2）线质量感知动态锚点评分（LQAS）利用质量监督、难负样本抑制和成对排序校准现有分类logits，无需增加额外推理分支。整体保持ADNet的推理管线不变。

Conclusion: GHVT模块与LQAS机制可协同解决锚点检测器在结构特征连续性和评分未对齐方面的问题，以最小计算代价提升车道检测性能，且不改变现有推理流程，具有良好的实用性和可迁移性。

Original Abstract: Lane detection requires recovering thin, elongated, and frequently occluded lane structures under challenging driving conditions. While anchor-based detectors provide efficient candidate generation, their performance is limited by two coupled issues: backbone features often lose structural continuity along partially visible lanes, and classification confidence may decouple from line-level localization quality, allowing inaccurate anchors to persist before non-maximum suppression (NMS). We propose a structure-enhanced and quality-aware framework that improves lane representation and dynamic-anchor scoring while preserving the inference pipeline of the Anchor Decomposition Network (ADNet). Specifically, a Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT) module enhances mid- and high-level backbone features via lightweight directional token interactions with a learnable residual gate. In parallel, Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS) calibrates existing classification logits using quality supervision, hard-negative suppression, and pairwise ranking without adding inference branches. Additional experiments on CULane and TuSimple datasets, extensive ablations, score-distribution diagnostics, and runtime analysis confirm complementary structural and ranking improvements with minimal computational overhead.

Original Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. To alleviate their massive computational overhead, temporal feature caching has been proposed to bypass redundant computations. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods driven by derivative-based polynomials often cause severe quality degradation under high acceleration due to unstable long-step predictions. To address this bottleneck, we propose Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement (BRACE). Motivated by the observation that DiT feature trajectories are globally smooth yet frequently exhibit sharp irregularities and local non-smoothness, BRACE shifts the paradigm from derivative-driven polynomial extrapolation to feature-driven rational forecasting. Specifically, it maintains a local sliding window to cache sparse historical features and leverages adapted Chebyshev weights to formulate a barycentric rational function, directly aggregating these raw features to ensure numerical stability. Motivation: 皮肤病变分类对皮肤癌的早期诊断至关重要，但皮肤镜图像中存在类别不平衡、类间相似性和类内变异性等问题，使得自动化分析面临挑战。现有方法仅依赖图像信息，难以充分解决上述难题，因此需要引入多模态信息（如图像与临床元数据）来提升诊断性能。

Method: 提出一种多模态分类框架，将基于Swin Transformer的图像特征与结构化临床元数据相结合，通过集成视觉-上下文学习实现联合建模。此外，应用温度缩放（temperature scaling）作为事后校准方法，并引入不确定性估计来评估模型预测的置信度。

Original Abstract: Skin lesion classification plays an important role in supporting the early diagnosis of skin cancer. However, automated analysis remains challenging due to class imbalance, inter-class similarity, and intra-class variability in dermoscopic images. This paper proposes a multimodal classification framework that combines Swin Transformer-based image features with structured clinical metadata to improve diagnostic performance through integrated visual-context learning. ### [27] [Geometry Beats Estimated Depth: RGB-Only Multi-Camera 3D Tracking under Sim2Real](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07579)
*Abdullah Naeem,Anav Katwal,Ayon Dey,Noman Khan,Md Tamjidul Hoque*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1（大型室内仓库多相机3D感知，Sim2Real设置，推理时仅RGB）提出假设：跨视图几何一致性而非单目深度精度主导Sim2Real性能。通过几何优先管线（13.0 3D HOTA）与伪LiDAR管线（0.12 HOTA）的对比验证了该假设，并揭示检测质量限制几何路线、定位一致性限制伪LiDAR路线的互补瓶颈。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在Sim2Real且仅RGB推理的多相机3D感知场景下，需要验证一个关键假设：跨视图几何一致性是否比单目深度精度更能决定性能表现。此前点云竞赛获胜者依赖深度信息，但深度在推理阶段不可用，因此需要评估纯RGB替代路线的可行性和主导因素。

Method: 构建两条纯RGB路线作为受控对比实验：(1) 几何优先管线：YOLO11x检测、单应性提升至世界坐标系、类别级3D尺寸先验、多相机融合、世界坐标跟踪及离线轨迹拼接；(2) 估计深度伪LiDAR管线：单目深度估计（D4RT, Metric3D v2）反投影为融合点云后送入3D检测器（V-DETR）。同时系统消融了SAHI检测、外观Re-ID、学习提升、RT-DETR集成、测试时增强和域随机化等干预手段。

Conclusion: 跨视图几何一致性是Sim2Real RGB-only多相机3D感知的主导因素，优于单目深度精度。几何优先方法稳健有效，而依赖单目深度估计的伪LiDAR路线因跨视角深度不一致而失败。检测质量与定位一致性构成两条路线的互补瓶颈，后续工作应聚焦于提升检测性能和跨视图深度一致性。

Original Abstract: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. We use two RGB-only routes as a controlled test of one hypothesis: that cross-view geometric consistency, not monocular depth accuracy, governs performance under Sim2Real. The first is a geometry-first pipeline: YOLO11x detection, homography lifting to the world frame, class-level 3D size priors, multi-camera fusion, world-coordinate tracking, and offline tracklet stitching. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. The gap is decisive: geometry-first reaches 13.0 3D HOTA (51.6 LocA), whereas pseudo-LiDAR collapses to 0.12 (9.2 LocA). We trace the collapse to cross-view inconsistency of monocular depth---scale correction is necessary but not sufficient---which domain-adaptation fine-tuning does not repair within budget. Within the geometry pipeline, offline stitching is the only intervention that helps; SAHI detection, appearance Re-ID, learned lifting, RT-DETR ensembling, test-time augmentation, and domain randomization all fail to beat the baseline detector. The bottlenecks are complementary: detection quality bounds the geometry route (DetA), localization consistency bounds pseudo-LiDAR (LocA). We release a complete, reproducible RGB-only pipeline and ablation.

中文摘要翻译: AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1在合成到真实（Sim2Real）设定下评估大型室内仓库中的多相机3D感知；深度信息仅用于训练和验证，推理阶段仅使用RGB。我们利用两条纯RGB路线作为一项受控测试，验证如下假设：在Sim2Real场景下，跨视图几何一致性而非单目深度精度决定性能表现。第一条路线是几何优先管线：YOLO11x检测、单应性提升至世界坐标系、类别级3D尺寸先验、多相机融合、世界坐标跟踪及离线轨迹拼接。第二条路线是估计深度的伪LiDAR：将单目深度（D4RT、Metric3D v2）反投影为融合点云并输入3D检测器（V-DETR），与之前依靠深度的点云竞赛获胜方案保持一致。两者差距显著：几何优先管线达到13.0的3D HOTA（51.6 LocA），而伪LiDAR管线崩溃至0.12（9.2 LocA）。我们将崩溃归因于单目深度的跨视图不一致性——尺度校正是必要但非充分条件——而域自适应微调在预算内无法修复该问题。在几何管线内部，离线轨迹拼接是唯一有效的干预手段；SAHI检测、外观Re-ID、学习式提升、RT-DETR集成、测试时增强以及域随机化均未能超越基线检测器。瓶颈具有互补性：检测质量（DetA）约束几何路线，定位一致性（LocA）约束伪LiDAR路线。我们发布了完整、可复现的纯RGB管线及消融实验。

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于全物理前向模型的野火温度反演框架，应用于NASA AVIRIS-3机载成像光谱数据。该框架利用GPU加速的非线性最小二乘方法在飞行周期内实现有效火温估计，并通过模拟光谱验证（RMSE为41.8 K）以及2025年FireSense全战役168次过境数据的SWIR残差拟合（≤10%）证明了其有效性，同时验证了反演结果可推广到EMIT等星载成像光谱仪。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 野火温度的准确反演对于火灾监测和辐射能量评估至关重要，但现有的反演方法在处理VSWIR成像光谱数据时存在计算效率和精度方面的挑战。作者希望开发一个能够在机载GPU上快速收敛的全物理反演框架，使有效火温估计能在飞行周期内完成，并验证其在不同空间分辨率平台上的泛化能力。

Method: 该方法采用全物理反演框架，通过前向模型同时解析来自温度分布的太阳辐射和火情发射辐射，并在残差拟合中利用全光谱范围。采用先进的非线性最小二乘方法在机载GPU上实现快速收敛，以优化前向模型反演。验证工作包括：在模拟光谱中注入热信号验证前向模型假设，对2025年FireSense AVIRIS-3战役的全部168次具有活跃火情光谱的过境数据进行反演，以及通过粗化空间分辨率验证后验火温参数向EMIT等星载光谱仪的泛化能力。

Result: 模拟光谱验证显示反演结果与注入热信号吻合良好，RMSE为41.8 K；在2025年FireSense AVIRIS-3战役的168次过境数据中，短波红外（SWIR）各波段的残差辐射拟合≤10%；在粗化空间分辨率下，后验分布对亚像素温度范围的覆盖率良好，各分位数的绝对误差为30 K，不同空间分辨率之间的平均绝对误差为27.16 K。

Conclusion: 该全物理野火温度反演框架能够在飞行周期内实现快速准确的火温估计，且反演得到的后验火温参数具有良好的跨平台泛化能力，可推广至EMIT等星载成像光谱仪，为机载和星载平台的野火温度监测提供了一种高效可行的技术方案。

Original Abstract: In this work, we present a wildfire temperature retrieval framework for VSWIR imaging spectroscopy data, employed on data from NASA's Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS-3). The retrieval framework utilizes a full-physics approach in which a forward model is employed to resolve both solar and emitted radiance derived from a temperature distribution and utilizes the full spectral range in the residual fit. To optimize the forward model retrieval, we use state-of-the-art nonlinear least squares methods implemented for fast convergence on the on-board GPU, allowing for estimation of effective fire temperature within flight cadence. We verify the forward model assumptions on simulated spectra with an injected thermal signature and find good agreement with an RMSE of $41.8$ Kelvin (K). We apply the retrieval over the full 2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 campaign, totaling 168 overflights with probable active fire spectra, and demonstrate a residual radiance fit of $\leq 10\%$ across bands in the short-wave infrared (SWIR). Lastly, we verify the applicability of the retrieved posterior fire temperature parameters to generalize to space-borne imaging spectrometers such as EMIT, by retrieving at coarsened spatial resolution. We find that the posterior distribution exhibits good coverage of the underlying sub-pixel temperature range with an absolute error of $30$ K across quantiles and a mean absolute error of $27.16$ K between spatial resolutions.

中文摘要翻译: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种适用于VSWIR成像光谱数据的野火温度反演框架，并将其应用于NASA机载可见近红外成像光谱仪（AVIRIS-3）的数据。该反演框架采用全物理方法，利用前向模型同时解析来自温度分布的太阳辐射和火情发射辐射，并在残差拟合中利用全光谱范围。为了优化前向模型反演，我们采用了最先进的非线性最小二乘方法，在机载GPU上实现快速收敛，从而能够在飞行周期内估计有效火温。我们在注入热特征的模拟光谱上验证了前向模型假设，结果与预期吻合良好，均方根误差（RMSE）为41.8开尔文（K）。我们将该反演方法应用于2025年FireSense AVIRIS-3战役的全部数据，共包含168次可能具有活跃火情光谱的过境，并证明了短波红外（SWIR）各波段的残差辐射拟合≤10%。最后，我们通过在粗化空间分辨率上进行反演，验证了所获得的后验火温参数可推广至EMIT等星载成像光谱仪。我们发现后验分布对底层亚像素温度范围具有良好的覆盖率，各分位数的绝对误差为30 K，不同空间分辨率之间的平均绝对误差为27.16 K。

### [29] [Multi-Branch Policy Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07581)
*Shuai Lyu,Yuning Gong,Ruiling Gao,Xiaoran Shang,Zhonghong Ou,Ping Zong,Yifan Zhu,Yuan Sun,Yang Qin,Peng Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多分支策略优化（MBPO），一种基于树的框架，用于解决多模态大语言模型在组级强化学习中因轨迹级均匀信用分配导致的问题，通过视觉-语言决策边界处构建推理树、分配分支级分段信用并引入时间回放缓冲区，在多个多模态推理基准上优于基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多模态推理中，基于组的强化学习方法通常对所有token施加单一优势值（轨迹级信用分配），但多模态推理比纯文本场景具有更高的感知不确定性，模型需要反复核查视觉信息，且不同的视觉锚定会导致不同的推理路径，使得统一的信用分配不充分，且相对优势会逐渐退化趋近于零。

Method: MBPO在视觉-语言决策边界处构建推理树，使兄弟分支能够探索多样的视觉假设；通过分支相对优势（branch-relative advantages）实现分段级别的信用分配；引入时间回放缓冲区（temporal replay buffer）以复用信息丰富的分段，同时控制策略过时（policy staleness）问题。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，MBPO优于代表性的基线方法，在提升学习信号质量和优化效率两方面均取得改进。

Conclusion: 通过树状推理框架和分段级信用分配，MBPO有效解决了多模态强化学习中均匀信用分配不足的问题，验证了分支级优势在多模态场景下的有效性，为多模态大语言模型的强化学习优化提供了新思路。

Original Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. However, multimodal reasoning involves substantially higher perceptual uncertainty than text-only settings, where the model must repeatedly re-examine visual information to verify intermediate interpretations, and different visual groundings can lead to divergent reasoning paths, making such uniform credit assignment particularly inadequate and causing relative advantages to progressively degenerate toward zero. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. We further introduce a temporal replay buffer to reuse informative segments while controlling policy staleness. Experiments on several multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that MBPO outperforms representative baselines, improving both learning signal quality and optimization efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShuaiLyu0110/MBPO.

中文摘要翻译: 基于组的多模态大语言模型强化学习方法通常依赖轨迹级信用分配，即对响应中的所有token施加单一优势值。然而，多模态推理相比纯文本场景涉及显著更高的感知不确定性，模型必须反复审视视觉信息以验证中间解释，且不同的视觉锚定可能导致发散性推理路径，这使得统一的信用分配尤为不充分，并导致相对优势逐渐退化趋近于零。为应对这些挑战，我们提出多分支策略优化（MBPO）——一种基于树的框架，在视觉-语言决策边界处构建推理树，使兄弟分支能够探索多样的视觉假设，并通过分支相对优势实现分段级信用分配。我们进一步引入时间回放缓冲区，以复用信息丰富的分段，同时控制策略过时问题。在多个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，MBPO优于代表性基线方法，在提升学习信号质量和优化效率两方面均取得改进。代码已公开于https://github.com/ShuaiLyu0110/MBPO。

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 数据中心中未计划的网络硬件故障会中断服务并导致高昂的停机成本，因此需要一种能够利用热成像和功率传感器数据提前发现设备故障早期迹象的预测性维护策略，以实现非侵入式的主动维护。

Method: 使用模拟数据集，包含标注的热成像图片和功率读数，对应三种运行状态（Normal、Warning、Critical）。评估三种ImageNet预训练CNN模型（ResNet-50、InceptionV3、VGG16），并提出一种多模态CNN-LSTM融合模型，整合视觉信息与传感器时间序列数据。实验对比了有无预处理（ROI提取和归一化）下的性能。

Result: 无预处理时CNN准确率中等（ResNet-50约52%）；ROI预处理显著提升性能（ResNet-50达91%）；CNN-LSTM多模态模型取得最高准确率94%，精确率和召回率接近95%。

Original Abstract: Unplanned network hardware malfunctions can interrupt services and result in expensive downtime in data centers. A deep learning-based predictive maintenance strategy is presented that utilizes thermal imaging and power sensor data to detect early indicators of equipment breakdown in routers, switches, and servers. A simulated dataset was generated comprising annotated thermal pictures and power readings indicative of three operating states: Normal, Warning, and Critical. Three ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) models ResNet-50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were assessed together with a multi-modal CNN-LSTM fusion model that integrates visual and sensor time-series information. Experiments were performed with and without pre-processing procedures, including region-of-interest (ROI) extraction and normalization. In the absence of pre-processing, CNNs attained moderate accuracy (e.g., ResNet-50 at 52%), but ROI-based pre-processing significantly enhanced performance (ResNet-50 accuracy reaching 91%). The CNN-LSTM model attained the greatest accuracy of 94%, with precision and recall approaching 95%, illustrating the effectiveness of multi-modal fusion. The results validate that domain-specific pre-processing and sensor fusion substantially improve early failure prediction, providing a potential foundation for proactive maintenance of network hardware through non-intrusive monitoring.

中文摘要翻译: 数据中心中未计划的网络硬件故障可能中断服务并导致高昂的停机时间。本文提出一种基于深度学习的预测性维护策略，利用热成像和功率传感器数据检测路由器、交换机和服务器中设备故障的早期迹象。生成了一份模拟数据集，包含标注的热成像图片和功率读数，对应三种运行状态：正常（Normal）、警告（Warning）和临界（Critical）。研究评估了三种基于ImageNet预训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）模型——ResNet-50、InceptionV3和VGG16，以及一种整合视觉与传感器时间序列信息的多模态CNN-LSTM融合模型。实验在有/无预处理流程（包括感兴趣区域（ROI）提取和归一化）的条件下进行。在缺乏预处理的情况下，CNN仅取得中等准确率（如ResNet-50为52%），而基于ROI的预处理显著提升了性能（ResNet-50准确率达到91%）。CNN-LSTM模型取得了最高的94%准确率，精确率和召回率接近95%，验证了多模态融合的有效性。结果表明，领域特定的预处理和传感器融合能大幅提升早期故障预测的性能，为通过网络硬件非侵入式监控实现主动维护提供了潜在基础。

### [31] [ComplexityWorld: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Verifiable Visual Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07584)
*Ningxin Pan,Hanyu Li,Yehui Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出COMPLEXITYWORLD基准，包含390个任务、39个领域类视觉世界和29个决策类别，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）从视觉证据做出满足全局约束的完整决策的能力。实验表明，除GPT-5.6-Sol外所有模型验证器接受率（VAR）低于40%，揭示了一个持续存在的"视觉到决策瓶颈"。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLM在视觉感知上取得显著进展，但许多真实世界任务不仅需要识别图像内容，还需要基于视觉证据做出满足全局约束的完整决策。现有基准未能充分评估这种"从视觉到决策"的能力，因此需要一个新的基准来系统性地衡量和揭示这一短板。

Method: 构建COMPLEXITYWORLD基准：从隐藏的结构化规范生成390个任务，涵盖39个领域类视觉世界和29个决策类别；每个任务渲染为视觉场景，并通过可执行的验证器对任意可行解进行评分，以验证器接受率（VAR）作为评估指标。

Result: 在直接推理下，除GPT-5.6-Sol（75.6% VAR）外，所有被评估模型VAR均低于40%；当决策信息以结构化形式显式呈现时性能显著提升，但在等价的视觉呈现方式下性能波动剧烈；智能体脚手架带来的增益较小且依赖于模型。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了VLM存在持续性的"视觉到决策瓶颈"，即模型难以从视觉证据中推导出满足全局约束的完整决策，而这种瓶颈仅靠增加推理计算无法消除。

Original Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made rapid progress in visual perception and increasingly support real-world tasks that depend on images. Many such tasks, however, require more than rec- ognizing what an image contains: a model must use visual evidence to make a complete decision whose parts jointly satisfy global constraints. We introduce COMPLEXITYWORLD, a benchmark of 390 tasks across 39 domain-inspired visual worlds and 29 decision categories. Each task is generated from a hidden structured specification, rendered as a visual scene, and scored by an exe- cutable verifier that accepts any feasible solution. Under direct inference, all evaluated models ex- cept GPT-5.6-Sol remain below 40% verifier ac- ceptance rate (VAR), while GPT-5.6-Sol reaches 75.6%. Performance improves substantially when the same decision information is made explicit in structured form, yet varies sharply across equiva- lent visual presentations. Agent scaffolds provide smaller, model-dependent gains. Together, these results reveal a persistent visual-to-decision bot- tleneck that additional inference alone does not remove.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉感知方面取得了快速进展，并日益支持依赖图像的真实世界任务。然而，许多此类任务需要的不仅仅是识别图像中包含的内容：模型必须利用视觉证据做出完整的决策，其各组成部分需共同满足全局约束。我们引入了COMPLEXITYWORLD，一个包含390个任务的基准，涵盖39个领域类视觉世界和29个决策类别。每个任务均由隐藏的结构化规范生成，渲染为视觉场景，并由一个可执行的验证器进行评分，该验证器接受任何可行解。在直接推理下，除GPT-5.6-Sol外，所有被评估模型的验证器接受率（VAR）均低于40%，而GPT-5.6-Sol达到了75.6%。当相同的决策信息以结构化形式显式呈现时，性能显著提升，但在等价的视觉呈现方式下性能波动剧烈。智能体脚手架提供的增益较小且因模型而异。综合来看，这些结果揭示了一个持续的"视觉到决策瓶颈"，仅靠额外的推理计算无法消除这一瓶颈。

</details>


### [32] [LAVE: Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning for Video Tool-use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07585)
*Zijian Wang,Junnan Zhu,Rongzhen Li,Xiao Liu,Guohui Xiang,Quan Lu,Lijia Liu,Yining Wang,Jiang Zhong,Kaiwen Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAVE是一个无需训练的框架，通过引入双通道观察接口（可见通道保留文本轨迹，潜在通道存储预语言视觉更新），解决视频工具使用智能体中工具-规划器通信仅依赖文本观察导致的观察瓶颈问题，实现潜在视觉证据的跨步骤复用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频工具使用智能体在工具-规划器通信中仅依赖文本观察，这种文本接口对工具计算结果的总结是有损的，导致未被语言化的视觉证据被丢弃，无法用于后续规划。作者将此识别为"工具观察瓶颈"问题。

Method: LAVE提出双通道观察接口：可见通道保留原始文本轨迹，潜在通道存储带工具角色、源帧时间戳和视觉位置的预语言视觉更新。在规划过程中，LAVE检索与当前规划器状态相关但未被文本观察覆盖的证据，通过有界时间戳对齐的潜在更新和熵约束的帧时间路由进行集成。

Result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和CG-Bench上的一致改进表明LAVE在不同骨干网络上均提升视频工具使用智能体性能。在可比帧预算下，LAVE在Video-MME上比最强基线提升3.76分。

Conclusion: 潜在视觉证据的复用能够有效增强多步视频智能体规划能力，且无需额外训练、帧重放或修改原始编排，验证了超越文本接口的视觉证据共享机制的可行性。

Original Abstract: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. Such text-only interfaces provide lossy summaries of Tool computations, causing previously computed visual evidence not verbalized to be discarded and unavailable for subsequent planning. We identify this limitation as the Tool observation bottleneck and propose Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE), a training-free framework for reusing latent visual evidence from completed Tool calls. LAVE introduces a dual-channel observation interface: the visible channel preserves the original textual trajectory, while the latent channel stores pre-verbal visual updates with their Tool roles, source-frame timestamps, and visual locations. During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. This enables video agents to reuse existing visual computation without additional training, frame replay, or modifications to the original orchestration. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and CG-Bench show that LAVE consistently improves video tool-use agents across backbones. Under a comparable frame budget, LAVE improves the Video-MME overall score by 3.76 points over the strongest baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of latent visual evidence reuse for multi-step video-agent planning.

中文摘要翻译: 长视频理解要求模型从冗长且冗余的视频流中高效获取并复用稀疏的视觉证据。近期视频工具使用智能体通过在不同时间尺度上迭代调用视觉工具来应对这一挑战，但其工具-规划器通信通常依赖文本观察。这种仅文本接口对工具计算结果提供了有损的总结，导致先前计算但未被语言化的视觉证据被丢弃，无法用于后续规划。我们将这一局限识别为工具观察瓶颈，并提出潜在视觉证据增强规划（LAVE），一个用于从已完成的工具调用中复用潜在视觉证据的免训练框架。LAVE引入双通道观察接口：可见通道保留原始文本轨迹，而潜在通道存储带有工具角色、源帧时间戳和视觉位置的预语言视觉更新。在规划过程中，LAVE检索与当前规划器状态相关但未被文本观察覆盖的证据，并通过有界时间戳对齐的潜在更新和熵约束的帧时间路由进行集成。这使得视频智能体无需额外训练、帧重放或修改原始编排即可复用已有的视觉计算。在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和CG-Bench上的大量实验表明，LAVE在不同骨干网络上持续提升视频工具使用智能体的性能。在可比帧预算下，LAVE在Video-MME总体得分上比最强基线提升3.76分，证明了潜在视觉证据复用对多步视频智能体规划的有效性。

</details>


### [33] [MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07586)
*Yousef Abdi,Mohammad Asadpour,Yousef Seyfari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MAGIC框架，通过流形锚定与几何增量校准解决无样本半监督类别增量学习中的特征漂移与伪标签不可靠问题，在多个基准上显著提升平均增量精度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 半监督类别增量学习（SSCIL）在无样本（exemplar-free）设置下极具挑战性，现有方法因特征漂移导致灾难性遗忘，且随着标签空间增长，伪标签的可靠性不断下降。需要一种无需存储旧数据的稳定策略来保持模型的可塑性。

Method: 提出MAGIC框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC)，利用图标签传播在可塑特征空间上对冻结骨干计算的类均值和方差进行加权校准，并从校准后的高斯分布中采样幻影特征替代旧任务数据；(2) Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) 目标，通过匹配学生和教师头部的关系统结构并锚定特征与固定分类器原型来保持表征拓扑，锁定特征空间方向。实现采用冻结的ResNet-18骨干结合可学习的塑性适配器。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R三个基准上，以1%、5%、10%标签比例评估，MAGIC相比大多数配备FixMatch的监督CIL方法和原生SSCIL基线提升了平均增量精度，在细粒度低标签设置中增益最大，该场景下置信度阈值法失效最明显。

Conclusion: MAGIC通过几何校准与结构对齐的联合约束，有效防止适配器漂移，使类间几何关系在新类别到来时保持稳定，无需存储样本即可实现半监督类别增量学习的性能提升。

Original Abstract: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. The second is a Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) objective that preserves representation topology by matching the relational structure of student and teacher heads and aligning feature anchors with the fixed classifier prototypes, locking the orientation of the feature space. Together, these constraints keep the adapter from drifting, so geometric relations between classes remain stable as new classes arrive. We implement MAGIC with a frozen ResNet-18 backbone and a learnable plastic adapter. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, at label ratios of 1%, 5%, and 10%, MAGIC improves average incremental accuracy over most of the supervised CIL methods equipped with FixMatch and native SSCIL baselines; the largest gains occur in the fine-grained, low-label setting, where confidence thresholding fails most clearly.

中文摘要翻译: 半监督类别增量学习（SSCIL）对神经网络而言是一项严峻挑战，而在无样本（exemplar-free）设置下尤为困难，因为该设置不允许存储任何过往数据。现有方法因特征漂移而遭受灾难性遗忘，并且随着标签空间的增长，其生成的伪标签变得越来越不可靠。本文提出MAGIC（流形锚定与几何增量校准，Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration）框架，该框架在不存储样本的前提下稳定模型的可塑性。MAGIC的设计围绕两个核心组件展开。第一个是软加权几何校准（SWGC），它利用基于图的标签传播在学习器的可塑特征空间上对冻结骨干网络计算的类均值与方差进行加权校准；基于这些校准后的高斯分布，我们采样幻影特征（phantom features）以替代先前任务的数据。第二个是几何结构对齐（GSA）目标，它通过匹配学生与教师头部的关系统结构，并将特征锚点与固定分类器原型对齐，从而保持表征拓扑结构，锁定特征空间的方向。这些约束共同防止适配器发生漂移，使得类间的几何关系在新类别到来时保持稳定。我们采用冻结的ResNet-18骨干网络和可学习的塑性适配器来实现MAGIC。在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R上，以1%、5%和10%的标签比例进行评估，MAGIC相比大多数配备FixMatch的监督CIL方法和原生SSCIL基线，提升了平均增量精度；最大的增益出现在细粒度、低标签设置中，而正是在该场景下，置信度阈值方法表现出的失效最为明显。

</details>


### [34] [NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07598)
*Lianlei Shan,Feiyang Ye,Yan Chen,Yong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NewtonGS 是一个基于物理结构的高斯场景对象级状态推演与动画框架，用22维对象状态结合高斯神经牛顿动力学（Gaussian-NND）模型实现对象运动预测与高斯场景动画生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有动态高斯方法主要聚焦于时变场景重建或形变模拟，无法提供紧凑的对象级状态用于直接控制。作者旨在弥补这一空白，实现对静态3D高斯场景中对象的可控动画。

Method: NewtonGS用22维状态向量（位姿、线速度、角速度、各向异性尺度及其变化率、质量、接触属性）表示每个对象，并提出Gaussian-NND模型，结合解析平移、四元数运动学、重力、阻尼和尺度恢复动力学与学习到的连续及接触残差。通过离散事件图处理地面接触，预测的位姿和尺度定义共享仿射变换，更新对象关联的所有高斯的均值和协方差。

Result: 在State-32数据集的分布内和速度范围偏移两个测试划分上，NewtonGS在轨迹RMSE、最终位移误差和速度RMSE上均优于五种解析基线；在Gaussian-32数据集上验证了从预测状态到高斯对象的有效转换。

Conclusion: NewtonGS提供了一种紧凑的物理结构化框架，能够将对象状态预测与高斯场景动画有效衔接，相比纯解析基线具有更高的预测精度，为可控动态高斯场景提供了新的方案。

Original Abstract: Animating objects in a static 3D Gaussian scene requires an explicit object-level dynamic state and a controllable model of object motion. Existing dynamic Gaussian methods primarily reconstruct time-varying scenes or simulate deformation, rather than provide compact object states for direct control. To address this gap, we present NewtonGS, a physics-structured framework for object-level state rollout and Gaussian scene animation. NewtonGS represents each object with a 22-dimensional state covering pose, linear and angular velocity, anisotropic scale and its rate, mass, and contact properties. Its Gaussian Neural Newtonian Dynamics (Gaussian-NND) model combines analytic translation, quaternion kinematics, gravity, damping, and scale-restoration dynamics with learned continuous and contact residuals. A discrete event map handles floor contact. Predicted poses and scales define a shared affine transformation that updates the means and covariances of all Gaussians associated with each object. We construct two procedurally generated datasets: State-32 for state-rollout evaluation and Gaussian-32 for state-to-Gaussian transformation. On both the in-distribution and velocity-range-shift splits of State-32, NewtonGS achieves lower trajectory RMSE, final displacement error, and velocity RMSE than five analytic baselines. Experiments on Gaussian-32 further demonstrate effective conversion from predicted states to animated Gaussian objects.

中文摘要翻译: 在静态3D高斯场景中动画化对象需要显式的对象级动态状态和可控的对象运动模型。现有的动态高斯方法主要重建时变场景或模拟形变，而非提供紧凑的对象状态用于直接控制。为解决这一空白，我们提出NewtonGS，一个面向对象级状态推演和高斯场景动画的物理结构化框架。NewtonGS将每个对象表示为22维状态，涵盖位姿、线速度和角速度、各向异性尺度及其变化率、质量和接触属性。其高斯神经牛顿动力学（Gaussian-NND）模型结合了解析平移、四元数运动学、重力、阻尼和尺度恢复动力学，并融合了学习得到的连续残差和接触残差。离散事件图用于处理地面接触。预测的位姿和尺度定义了共享仿射变换，用于更新与每个对象关联的所有高斯的均值和协方差。我们构建了两个程序生成的数据集：用于状态推演评估的State-32，以及用于状态到高斯变换的Gaussian-32。在State-32的分布内和速度范围偏移两个测试划分上，NewtonGS在轨迹均方根误差、最终位移误差和速度均方根误差上均优于五种解析基线。在Gaussian-32上的实验进一步证明了从预测状态到动画化高斯对象的有效转换。

</details>


### [35] [HSMLA: Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention for Efficient Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07616)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu,Renata Borovica-Gajic,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HSMLA是一种层级Softmax多尺度线性注意力机制，通过结合ReLU线性注意力、选择性Softmax细化和深度可分离卷积的多尺度token表示，在高分辨率密集预测任务中实现了精度与效率的优越平衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 视觉Transformer在高分辨率密集预测中面临显著的计算开销，源于自注意力的二次复杂度。线性注意力虽高效但牺牲了局部上下文建模能力，因此需要一种既能保持全局建模又能兼顾局部特征且计算高效的方法。

Method: 提出HSMLA（层级Softmax多尺度线性注意力），由三部分组成：(1) 基于ReLU的线性注意力用于捕获全局上下文；(2) 选择性Softmax细化机制用于保留关键局部特征；(3) 通过深度可分离卷积生成多尺度token表示。

Result: 在密集预测任务中实现高达4.2倍推理加速；CT器官分割任务达到87.3% Dice并获3.2倍加速；病理WSI任务达到94.2% AUC并获4.1倍加速，展示了优越的精度-效率权衡。

Conclusion: HSMLA通过层次化融合线性注意力与选择性Softmax机制，有效解决了线性注意力在局部上下文建模上的不足，在多种高分辨率医学图像密集预测任务上同时实现了显著加速和优异性能。

Original Abstract: Vision transformers face significant computational overheads in high-resolution dense prediction due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Linear attention offers efficiency but sacrifices local context modeling. We propose \textbf{HSMLA (Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention)}, which combines ReLU-based linear attention for global context, selective softmax refinement for critical local features, and multi-scale token representations via depthwise convolutions. HSMLA achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: up to $4.2\times$ inference-time speedup across dense prediction tasks, $87.3%$ Dice with $3.2\times$ speedup on CT organ segmentation, and $94.2%$ AUC with $4.1\times$ speedup on pathology WSI.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉Transformer在高分辨率密集预测中面临显著的计算开销，原因是自注意力的二次复杂度。线性注意力虽然高效，但牺牲了局部上下文建模能力。我们提出了HSMLA（层级Softmax多尺度线性注意力），它将基于ReLU的线性注意力用于全局上下文建模、选择性Softmax细化用于关键局部特征，以及通过深度可分离卷积实现的多尺度token表示相结合。HSMLA实现了优越的精度-效率权衡：在密集预测任务中最高获得4.2倍推理加速，在CT器官分割中达到87.3%的Dice系数并获3.2倍加速，在病理WSI上达到94.2%的AUC并获4.1倍加速。

</details>


### [36] [FlowErase-OPD: Multi-Concept Erasure via Anchored On-Policy Distillation in Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07620)
*Yi Sun,Yimin Zhou,Xinhao Zhong,Zhiqi Zhang,Junhao Li,Bin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowErase-OPD 是一个基于在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）的多概念擦除框架，用于流匹配模型的安全生成。它通过统一LoRA模块蒸馏多个单概念擦除模型，引入锚定多教师蒸馏（AMTD）和自适应保留控制（ARC）来优化擦除效果与生成能力之间的权衡，在裸体、物体和艺术风格擦除等多个任务上达到SOTA性能，并对对抗攻击具有鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有针对流匹配模型的概念擦除方法主要集中在单个概念的移除，同时高效擦除多个概念仍然具有挑战性。多概念擦除需要在多个擦除目标之间以及擦除效果与生成能力保留之间寻找平衡，因此需要一个新的框架来解决这一问题。

Method: 首先将多个单概念擦除模型蒸馏到一个统一的LoRA模块中；提出锚定多教师蒸馏（AMTD），引入一个保留教师（retention teacher）来缓解概念擦除与生成能力保留之间的权衡；进一步发展自适应保留控制（ARC），动态调整每个擦除教师的采样频率和损失权重，以及擦除教师与保留教师在整个训练过程中的相对贡献。

Result: 在裸体、物体和艺术风格擦除的大量实验中，FlowErase-OPD在多概念擦除的多种设置下持续改善了擦除有效性、图像质量和语义对齐之间的权衡，达到最先进性能。此外，生成的模型对对抗攻击表现出强大的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 在线策略蒸馏可以作为流匹配模型中安全、可控生成的原理性框架，具有广阔的应用潜力。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in flow matching models have substantially improved the quality of text-to-image generation, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods for flow matching models predominantly focus on removing individual concepts, while effectively erasing multiple concepts simultaneously remains challenging. We propose FlowErase-OPD, a framework for multi-concept erasure based on on-policy distillation (OPD). Our approach first distills multiple single-concept erased models into a unified LoRA module and introduces Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation (AMTD), which incorporates a retention teacher to mitigate the trade-off between concept erasure and preservation of generative capabilities. To further improve the coordination of multiple erasure objectives, we develop Adaptive Retention Control (ARC), which dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and loss weight of each erasure teacher, together with the relative contribution of erasure and retention teachers throughout training. Extensive experiments on nudity, object, and artistic-style erasure demonstrate that FlowErase-OPD consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse multi-concept erasure settings. Furthermore, the resulting models exhibit strong robustness against adversarial attacks. These results highlight the potential of on-policy distillation as a principled framework for safe and controllable generation in flow matching models.

中文摘要翻译: 近年来，流匹配模型（flow matching models）的进展显著提升了文生图（text-to-image）生成的質量，但同时也因其可能生成有害或不良内容而引发了日益增长的安全担忧。现有的流匹配模型概念擦除方法主要侧重于移除单个概念，而同时有效擦除多个概念仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了FlowErase-OPD，一个基于在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）的多概念擦除框架。我们的方法首先将多个单概念擦除模型蒸馏到一个统一的LoRA模块中，并引入锚定多教师蒸馏（Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation, AMTD），通过一个保留教师（retention teacher）来缓解概念擦除与生成能力保留之间的权衡。为进一步改善多个擦除目标的协调性，我们开发了自适应保留控制（Adaptive Retention Control, ARC），动态调整每个擦除教师的采样频率和损失权重，以及擦除教师与保留教师在训练过程中的相对贡献。在裸体、物体和艺术风格擦除的大量实验表明，FlowErase-OPD在擦除有效性、图像质量和语义对齐之间的权衡上持续取得改善，在多种多概念擦除设置下达到最先进性能。此外，所得模型对对抗攻击表现出强大的鲁棒性。这些结果凸显了在线策略蒸馏作为流匹配模型中安全可控生成原理性框架的潜力。

</details>


### [37] [HeatCast: A Benchmark for Neighborhood-Scale LST Forecasting across 124 U.S. Cities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07640)
*Jesus Guerrero,Isaac Corley,Leon Najafirad,Maryam Tabar,Paul Rad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HeatCast是一个基于Landsat的月度地表温度（LST）预测基准，覆盖2013年至2025年6月美国124个城市，提供30米分辨率数据、固定时间划分、LCZ分层评估指标和参考评估框架，并评估了CNN+LSTM与Earthformer两种模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 目前缺乏用于30米分辨率地表温度预测的共享基准。以往研究通常仅覆盖一到三个城市、使用千米级产品，或未公开数据和代码，导致结果难以复现和比较。该论文旨在填补这一空白，建立一个大规模、标准化的LST预测基准。

Method: 构建HeatCast基准数据集，包含30米月度LST瓦片、高程、地表反射率RGB、三个光谱指数、宽波段反照率、质量掩膜以及局地气候带（LCZ）标签；设定固定的时间划分、LCZ分层评估指标和参考评估框架；使用CNN+LSTM和Earthformer两种模型进行下月预测评估，并比较不同输入通道（非LST八通道、LST历史、RGB）的预测性能。

Result: Earthformer在下月预测任务中达到7.74 K RMSE，优于CNN+LSTM的10.42 K RMSE。仅使用八个非LST通道预测达到7.72 K RMSE，优于仅使用LST历史（8.15 K）和仅使用RGB（8.68 K）的效果。

Conclusion: HeatCast提供了一套可复现、可扩展的30米分辨率LST预测基准，实验表明非LST环境通道在LST预测中具有重要价值，且Earthformer表现优于CNN+LSTM。数据、代码和权重已在MIT许可下开源发布。

Original Abstract: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m. Prior studies usually cover one to three cities, use kilometer-scale products, or do not release data and code. We introduce HeatCast, a Landsat-based benchmark for monthly LST forecasting across 124 U.S. cities from 2013 through June 2025. HeatCast contains 30 m monthly tiles with LST, elevation, surfacereflectance RGB, three spectral indices, broadband albedo, quality masks, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) labels, together with a fixed temporal split, LCZ-stratified metrics, and a reference evaluation harness. We evaluate a CNN+LSTM and Earthformer on next-month forecasting, where Earthformer reaches 7.74 K RMSE against 10.42 K for the CNN+LSTM. Forecasting from the eight nonLST channels alone reaches 7.72 K, against 8.15 K from LST history and 8.68 K from RGB. The data, code, and weights are released under MIT at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9889.

中文摘要翻译: 地表温度（LST）是一种广泛使用的、基于卫星获取的城市地表热量度量指标，但目前尚无用于30米分辨率LST预测的共享基准。以往研究通常仅覆盖一到三个城市、使用千米级产品，或未公开数据和代码。我们推出HeatCast——一个基于Landsat的月度LST预测基准，覆盖2013年至2025年6月美国124个城市。HeatCast包含30米月度瓦片，涵盖LST、高程、地表反射率RGB、三个光谱指数、宽波段反照率、质量掩膜以及局地气候带（LCZ）标签，同时提供固定的时间划分、LCZ分层评估指标和参考评估框架。我们评估了CNN+LSTM和Earthformer在下月预测任务上的表现，其中Earthformer达到7.74 K的RMSE，而CNN+LSTM为10.42 K。仅使用八个非LST通道进行预测达到7.72 K，相比之下，仅使用LST历史数据为8.15 K，仅使用RGB为8.68 K。数据、代码和权重已在MIT许可下发布于https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9889。

</details>


### [38] [Data collection from highways: a geometric, class-agnostic approach to embedded vehicle counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07643)
*Lucas Gouveia Omena Lopes,William W. M. Lira,Alexandre M. Lima,Thales M. A. Vieira*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了一种纯几何的交通感知管线，用于在树莓派等单板计算机上实现与类别无关的车辆计数。该方法基于背景减除和阈值化检测运动物体，并通过虚拟感应线圈上的几何规则计数，无需物体模型、训练集或逐物体轨迹，在实时性、准确性和能耗上均优于基于YOLO等深度检测器的跟踪-检测流水线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前交通数据采集主要依赖深度物体检测器加跟踪-检测流水线，但这预设了检测器已针对目标类别训练好，而实际中往往缺乏标注数据。作者希望探索一种纯粹基于几何的、不依赖物体模型的交通感知管线，以解决边缘设备上的类别无关车辆计数问题。

Method: 提出两种计数规则：(1) 常均速规则：假设车辆以恒定平均速度通过，通过几何推理在虚拟感应线上计数，并在高斯速度分布假设下解析推导期望精度；(2) 自校准预标定规则：从斑点（blob）统计量中恢复车道几何，通过对车道占用边沿进行计数，同时无需额外成本即可获得每辆车平均速度。检测部分采用背景减除和阈值化的类别无关运动检测，可运行于树莓派级硬件。

Result: 常均速规则在高斯速度分布下理论精度约86%；自校准规则在四个视频上达到83.3%-100%精度；在野外部署中达到91%，而同一计算预算下的斑点跟踪基线仅为37.5%。此外还发现了分辨率下限、帧率下限（车辆混叠经过计数线）、短片段与现实长视频的差距，以及Python（100% CPU）与C++（40% CPU，热可行）之间的权衡。

Original Abstract: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.

TL;DR: 本文提出MERIT框架，针对超长视频（小时到天级别）理解问题，通过构建场景记忆时优先保证高召回的可检索性，并在推理时进行按需时间扩展来组合高层语义关系，简单高效地实现了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在超长视频上的理解能力。MERIT采用多键情景化键匹配机制和邻域过滤机制，在EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME（Long）三个长视频基准上达到最先进水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 超长视频（数小时到数天）无法被当前多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接端到端处理，需要两阶段范式（查询无关的记忆构建+检索式推理）。现有工作将大量算力投入到复杂的记忆构建中，试图预先建模视频中的高层关系，但构建时并不知道下游查询是什么。作者认为应优先保证记忆构建阶段的高召回可检索性，将查询特定的高层关系组合延迟到推理阶段完成，从而提升效率并简化记忆构建。

Method: MERIT框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 情景化多键表示（episodic multi-key representation）：利用简单的键匹配机制精确检索细粒度记忆；(2) 邻域过滤机制（neighbor filtering）：仅在推理时围绕检索到的片段进行时间范围的按需扩展，从而在不进行全局记忆构建的巨大计算开销下捕获更广泛的语义上下文。整体采用智能体（agentic）框架，先构建高召回的记忆库，再在推理阶段通过键匹配和临时时间扩展组合同检索结果相关的高层关系。

Result: MERIT在三个长视频基准测试上均取得了最先进（State-of-the-Art）的表现，包括EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME（Long）。验证了"构建时保证高召回可检索性+推理时按需时间扩展"这一策略在超长视频理解中的有效性。

Conclusion: 在超长视频理解中，不必在记忆构建阶段就预先建模所有高层关系；通过将计算重心从构建阶段转移到推理阶段的按需扩展，即采用简单的键匹配加推理时的临时扩展策略，即可更高效且更准确地实现超长视频理解。MERIT证明了这一简洁设计相对于复杂记忆构建方案的优势。

Original Abstract: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).

中文摘要翻译: 当视频时长从数小时延长到数天时，直接端到端处理对于当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言变得不切实际。这种超长视频设置需要两阶段范式：先进行查询无关的记忆构建，再进行基于检索的推理。先前的工作在复杂的记忆构建上投入大量算力，试图预先建模视频中的高层关系，尽管在构建时并不知道下游查询是什么。我们更倾向于在记忆构建阶段优先保证高召回的可检索性，并将查询特定、高层的关系组合推迟到推理阶段进行。为此，我们提出了MERIT（多键情景化检索与推理时时间扩展），一个简洁而有效的用于超长视频理解的智能体框架。首先，我们构建了情景化多键表示，通过简单的键匹配机制实现对细粒度记忆的精确检索。其次，我们引入邻域过滤机制以捕获更广泛的语义上下文，而无需全局记忆构建带来的巨大计算开销。这是通过在推理时仅围绕检索到的片段扩展时间范围来实现的。借助简单的键匹配配合这种按需时间扩展，MERIT在三个长视频基准测试——EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME（Long）——上均取得了最先进的性能。

To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. Motivation: 现有潜在医学图像生成器通常将tokenizer视为固定的预处理步骤，但这种分离是否有效并未被系统验证。作者旨在通过受控实验检验tokenizer、生成器与采样器之间的交互关系，并质疑仅凭重建PSNR作为tokenizer选择标准的可靠性。

In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ViWi框架，将对象中心式的物槽（material slots）表示与WiFi波段电磁仿真生成的射频描述符相结合，实现体素级别的体积力学属性估计，在多项基准上超越现有最优方法。

  <summary>Details</summary>

These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.

Besides increasing dimensionality, operations on the imaginary parts provide algebraic and geometrical properties that can be beneficial for solving machine learning problems. In this paper, we show how to create hypercomplex-valued neural network layers where the real part corresponds to the output of a traditional real-valued layer. The additional imaginary parts of these hypercomplex-valued layers produce what we call ``ghost features,'' which contain enhanced information that is not present in the output of the real-valued layer. Moreover, ghost features can be effectively integrated into a trained neural network through a process we refer to as ``spooky transfer learning.'' This approach allows us to harness the richness of ghost features, leading to more efficient neural networks. *Saim Rehman,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BRUCE框架，系统性地对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在各种图像扰动和失真下的多模态推理鲁棒性进行基准测试，并引入RCI和T-RCI两个新指标量化推理性能随扰动严重程度恶化的速率，同时通过四类高层推理域（OCR依赖推理、空间推理、符号推理和语义失败）提供可解释的失败分析。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有最先进的评估框架主要关注干净任务上的准确率，很少分析推理稳定性如何随鲁棒性维度退化。然而视觉-语言模型在真实场景中常因输入图像质量低或质量不稳定而出现鲁棒性问题，因此亟需一个系统性的基准框架来分析VLM在输入扰动下的多模态推理鲁棒性退化情况。

Method: BRUCE通过对输入图像施加多种扰动和失真（如模糊、低对比度等），采用渐进式扰动缩放策略，提出两个新指标——鲁棒性腐败指数（RCI）和遍历RCI（T-RCI）——来量化VLM多模态推理性能随视觉腐败严重程度递增的退化速率；并在化学和数学推理任务的多数据集上进行评估，同时将腐败诱导的预测失败按四个高层推理域（OCR依赖推理、空间推理、符号推理、语义失败）进行分类分析，每个域包含细粒度的腐败特定失败子类型。

Result: 在化学和数学推理任务的多个数据集上评估了BRUCE框架，并通过四类高层推理域及其细粒度失败子类型提供了可解释的失败分析，揭示了VLM在不同扰动类型和严重程度下的推理稳定性退化模式。

Conclusion: BRUCE为VLM多模态推理鲁棒性提供了系统化的基准评估框架，通过RCI和T-RCI指标以及可解释的失败域分类，实现了对VLM在视觉腐败下推理退化的量化与深入理解。

Original Abstract: Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning.
  State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: LoRSA是一种全局-残差适配框架，联合学习一个稠密低秩组件（捕获全局协调的任务适配）和一个动态结构化稀疏低秩组件（提供残差校正，其支持集在训练过程中演化），并系统地表征了该分解的表示容量、逼近性质、秩结构及奇异子空间互补性。

Original Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. This restriction may prevent the model from simultaneously representing globally shared task structure and localized residual directions required for generalization to unseen imaging domains. We introduce LoRSA, a global--residual adaptation framework that jointly learns a dense low-rank component and a dynamically structured-sparse low-rank component. The dense component captures globally coordinated task adaptation, while the structured component provides complementary residual corrections whose support evolves during training. We characterize the representational capacity, approximation properties, rank structure, and singular-subspace complementarity of this decomposition. We evaluate LoRSA for four-class breast-density classification using DINOv3-Base, with VinDr-Mammo as the source domain and MammosighTR and RSNA as unseen external domains. TL;DR: 提出一种利用多任务视觉感知系统中的任务间输出不一致性来高效检测对抗攻击的方法，在BDD100k数据集上对PGD攻击实现了99.9%的ROC-AUC检测性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 通过利用多任务视觉感知系统内部的输出一致性作为天然信号来检测对抗攻击，可以在不引入显著计算开销的前提下实现高效的对抗攻击检测，适合资源受限的实际应用场景，为自动驾驶等安全攸关系统的对抗防御提供了实用方案。

In this work, we propose an efficient and effective adversarial attack detection scheme leveraging the multi-task perception within a complex vision system. Adversarial perturbations are detected by the inconsistencies between the inference outputs of multiple vision tasks, e.g., object detection and instance segmentation. To this end, we developed a consistency score metric to measure the inconsistency between vision tasks. Next, we designed an approach to select the best model pairs for detecting inconsistencies effectively. Conclusion: 采集感知的采样策略能够提供更稳定的几何表示，应被视为单扫描3D分割中的主动组件，而非通用的预处理步骤。

Original Abstract: 3D scene understanding is increasingly important in construction, yet most methods are developed on curated datasets that do not fully reflect real site sensing conditions. In many workflows, individual LiDAR scans provide rapid local updates rather than complete scene representations, producing limited surface coverage, acquisition-driven density variation, and severe imbalance between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements. Because large point clouds must be downsampled, sampling resolution and point allocation directly affect the balance between geometric detail and spatial context. This study evaluates these effects under a fixed per-fragment point budget and introduces an incidence-aware sampling strategy for individual LiDAR scans. The method maps points to a geometry-normalized manifold space for voxel-based selection while preserving original Euclidean coordinates for downstream learning.
